005package org.wpilib.event;
006
007import java.util.ConcurrentModificationException;
008import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
009import org.wpilib.util.container.WeakLinkedHashSet;
010
011/**
012 * A declarative way to bind a set of actions to a loop and execute them when the loop is polled.
013 */
014public final class EventLoop {
015  // Keep all bindings in one insertion-ordered collection for polling.
016  private final WeakLinkedHashSet<Runnable> m_bindings = new WeakLinkedHashSet<>();
017  // Keep strong references for strongly bound actions to prevent garbage collection.
018  private final LinkedHashSet<Runnable> m_strongBindings = new LinkedHashSet<>();
019  private boolean m_running;
020
021  /** Default constructor. */
022  public EventLoop() {}
023
024  /**
025   * Bind a new action to run when the loop is polled. The event loop keeps a reference to the
026   * action, which will prevent it from being garbage collected. If memory leaks are a concern,
027   * consider {@link #bindWeak(Runnable)}.
028   *
029   * @param action the action to run.
030   */
031  public void bind(Runnable action) {
032    if (m_running) {
033      throw new ConcurrentModificationException("Cannot bind EventLoop while it is running");
034    }
035    m_bindings.add(action);
036    m_strongBindings.add(action);
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Weakly binds a new action to run when the loop is polled. Unlike {@link #bind(Runnable)}, a
041   * weakly bound action will not be prevented from being garbage collected.
042   *
043   * @param action the action to run
044   */
045  public void bindWeak(Runnable action) {
046    if (m_running) {
047      throw new ConcurrentModificationException("Cannot bind EventLoop while it is running");
048    }
049    m_bindings.add(action);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Checks if an action is bound to the event loop.
054   *
055   * @param action the action to check
056   * @return true if the action is bound, false if not
057   */
058  public boolean isBound(Runnable action) {
059    return m_bindings.contains(action);
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Unbind an action from running when the loop is polled. Has no effect if the given action is not
064   * already bound.
065   *
066   * @param action the action to unbind.
067   */
068  public void unbind(Runnable action) {
069    if (m_running) {
070      throw new ConcurrentModificationException("Cannot unbind EventLoop while it is running");
071    }
072    m_bindings.remove(action);
073    m_strongBindings.remove(action);
074  }
075
076  /** Poll all bindings. */
077  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.UnusedAssignment")
078  public void poll() {
079    try {
080      m_running = true;
081      m_bindings.forEach(Runnable::run);
082    } finally {
083      m_running = false;
084    }
085  }
086
087  /** Clear all bindings. */
088  public void clear() {
089    if (m_running) {
090      throw new ConcurrentModificationException("Cannot clear EventLoop while it is running");
091    }
092    m_bindings.clear();
093    m_strongBindings.clear();
094  }
095}
